description:
Get nightly HRV (heart rate variability, in ms) from the local cache: last-night average, highest 5-minute value, 7-day average, the personal baseline range (balanced low/high) and Garmin's status (BALANCED, UNBALANCED, LOW, POOR).

With readings_date, also returns that night's 5-minute HRV readings (fetched from Garmin if older than the synced detail window).

Defaults to the last 28 nights, at most 366 per call. HRV needs a compatible watch worn overnight; history starts when that began.

readings_date.description: Night (wake-up date) to include 5-minute readings for

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for complete structured data

name: garmin_get_hrv
title: Heart rate variability
